title: cddlc test suite: RFC 8610 and RFC 9165 constructs

cases.reason: RFC 8610 §3.8.1 defines `.size` for byte strings, text strings and unsigned integers; this library does not accept `int` as the target of `.size` (`uint .size N` works), where cddlc applies it to the non-negative integers.
